name: Podcast On Air
tagline: heditor's podcast: tilted camera print, ON AIR sign, Bebas karaoke with the word black on a rotating yellow / cyan / pink pill.

motion.direction: heditor `podcast`. A plum set with halftone, the speaker as a tilted (−3°) print; captions are Bebas Neue karaoke, 1–3 words, each group popping from 0.25 → 1.06 in 0.16 s, the spoken word black on a pill whose colour rotates yellow `gold` → cyan `goldd` → pink. Every claim gets a `posterText` in coral `ter` or a `chips` row; numbers roll as `counter`; a `stamp` ON AIR / HOT TAKE on verdicts; wipes 0.46 s between segments. Something new every 2 s; loud, warm, never dark text on a mid-tone pill.
